name: Webcore

influenced_by: late-1990s/early-2000s GeoCities and personal-homepage web design

eras: lived era late 1990s–early 2000s; aesthetic named/revived c. 2019–present
places: GeoCities, Angelfire and other early personal-homepage hosts
garments: not primarily a fashion look — a web-design aesthetic, though it has a minor clothing-graphic crossover with y2k
reacts_against: the smooth, templated look of modern social media profiles, celebrating early the web's handmade, chaotic, GIF-heavy personal pages instead.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Nostalgic internet imagery (GeoCities, Windows XP), pixel art, early 3D graphics, browser windows, surrealism, pop-ups, error messages, outdated technology
wiki_facts.key_colours: Bright primary colors, often with digital distortion or pastel filters
wiki_facts.key_values: Nostalgia (anemoia), critique of the modern corporate internet, digital surrealism, creativity

findings: a vivid streak — roughly 54% of the color measured is highly saturated
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
